mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_event ( event_id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, exchange_name, routing_key, payload_json, idempotency_key, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, last_error, created_at, updated_at, published_at ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{eventType}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{exchangeName}, #{routingKey}, CAST(#{payloadJson} AS jsonb), #{idempotencyKey}, 'NEW', 0, NULL, NULL, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt}, NULL ) ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO outbox_event ( event_id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, exchange_name, routing_key, payload_json, idempotency_key, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, last_error, created_at, updated_at, published_at ) VALUES
( #{event.eventId}, #{event.eventType}, #{event.aggregateType}, #{event.aggregateId}, #{event.exchangeName}, #{event.routingKey}, CAST(#{event.payloadJson} AS jsonb), #{event.idempotencyKey}, 'NEW', 0, NULL, NULL, #{event.createdAt}, #{event.createdAt}, NULL )
ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: WITH candidates AS ( SELECT event_id FROM outbox_event WHERE ( status IN ('NEW', 'RETRY') AND retry_count < #{maxRetry} AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW()) ) OR ( status = 'PROCESSING' AND updated_at <= NOW() - (#{processingTimeoutMs} * INTERVAL '1 millisecond') ) ORDER BY created_at ASC, event_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ), claimed AS ( UPDATE outbox_event e SET status = 'PROCESSING', updated_at = NOW() FROM candidates c WHERE e.event_id = c.event_id RETURNING e.event_id, e.event_type, e.aggregate_type, e.aggregate_id, e.exchange_name, e.routing_key, e.payload_json, e.idempotency_key, e.retry_count, e.created_at ) SELECT event_id AS "eventId", event_type AS "eventType", aggregate_type AS "aggregateType", aggregate_id AS "aggregateId", exchange_name AS "exchangeName", routing_key AS "routingKey", payload_json::text AS "payloadJson", idempotency_key AS "idempotencyKey", retry_count AS "retryCount", created_at AS "createdAt" FROM claimed
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = #{publishedAt}, updated_at = #{publishedAt}, last_error = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE outbox_event SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, status = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 >= #{maxRetry} THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'RETRY' END, next_retry_at = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 >= #{maxRetry} THEN NULL ELSE #{nextRetryAt} END, last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
